notes: Mirrors ConfigManager.init's else branch (line 143-147): no file at all, so defaults are used directly — no corrupt-file preservation, since there was never a file to preserve. Also mirrors that branch's own save() call: defaults are persisted to path immediately, so the next load finds a real file instead of re-deriving defaults every time. The sibling '.keep' file exists only so FakeFileSystem recognizes '/srv/app' as an existing directory (per fs.rs, a fake directory's existence is inferred from a child file) — config.json itself is genuinely absent.
